_comment: Provenance is DERIVED (scripts/vendor-index.sh) from this file + the pristine
checkout + the files on disk. Add a path here only when the derived default is
native        file is our code living at an upstream path (no parity claim)
upstream_ports :app port -> the upstream file it was derived from (native)
derived_from  :telegram file whose real upstream source differs from its path
forced_exact  hand-feel subsystems that must stay upstream-shaped
resources     copied resource groups (not per-file tracked)
Never list byte-clean copies: they are derived from the pristine tree.

policy.why: NativeDo is a linux.do client, not a Telegram fork: the snapshot advances only when a product goal needs upstream code, never on every upstream release.

reference.why: Carried from the first vendoring pass (Telegram 12.6.x). Historical reference only: these files are not re-synced against the current pin, so both vendor-diff and the derived `modified` flag use this commit as their baseline.
